source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently test the assigned ordinary-language keyword cumulonimbus convective storm structure in one randomized, complex, photorealistic environmental portrait, using the supplied image only for visible adult appearance continuity and making the storm anatomy the primary legible subject.
subject: An unmistakably adult environmental reporter with long dark softly waved hair, small in frame beneath a complete cumulonimbus convective storm structure.
setting: A rain-darkened cracked dry-lake basin at sunset, open to an uninterrupted horizon and immense storm sky.
event: A gust front arrives before the heavy rain, visibly sweeping rain mist and dust across the basin while the reporter braces into the wind.
visual_priorities: The full storm anatomy remains dominant and simultaneously legible from dark base through vertical tower and flattened anvil to the precipitation shaft.
The referenced adult appearance remains visibly continuous while the person stays small and does not occlude any storm component.
Wind-driven surface motion, wet cracked clay, and the boundary between clear foreground air and storm outflow remain physically coherent.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic wide environmental portrait on a rain-darkened cracked dry-lake basin at sunset. A full cumulonimbus convective storm structure dominates the photograph: a dark, low cloud base; an immense vertically billowing tower; a broad, flattened anvil; and a distant opaque precipitation shaft. The gust front is visibly sweeping rain mist and dust across the cracked basin. In the lower-left foreground, an unmistakably adult environmental reporter with long dark softly waved hair braces into the wind, holding a closed field notebook against a weatherproof ochre coat. Render visible general facial appearance continuity from the supplied appearance reference, understood as resemblance rather than identity. Frame at 28 mm from a low eye-level viewpoint; the person occupies about twelve percent of the image and leaves the storm base, tower, anvil, and rain shaft unobstructed. Amber sunset light rims the reporter and wet clay while blue-black cloud shadows hold the immense sky. Emphasize physically coherent scale, turbulent cloud texture, wind-driven surface motion, and a readable transition from clear foreground air into the storm's outflow.
